# mailtrap_email_template (Resource)

Manages a reusable Mailtrap email template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailtrap_email_template" "example" {
  name      = "Welcome"
  category  = "Onboarding"
  subject   = "Welcome aboard, {{name}}!"
  body_html = "<h1>Hello {{name}}</h1><p>Thanks for signing up.</p>"
  body_text = "Hello {{name}}, thanks for signing up."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Category of the template.
- `name` (String) Name of the template.
- `subject` (String) Subject line of emails sent with the template.

### Optional

- `body_html` (String) HTML body. The API cannot clear a body once set: removing this attribute keeps the last value on the server.
- `body_text` (String) Plain-text body. The API cannot clear a body once set: removing this attribute keeps the last value on the server.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the template.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an email template by its numeric ID.
terraform import mailtrap_email_template.example 12345
```
